section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种人工智能的机器学习设备，涉及机器学习设备技术领域，包括：安装座、显示机构、识别机构、供电机构和散热机构，所述安装座内开设有安装腔，所述安装腔内固定安装有主机主体，所述安装座顶部的一侧固定安装有桌面启动器，所述主机主体与桌面启动器电性连接。本实用新型中，通过读卡器识别使用者身份信息，并读取数据库中该使用者所从事的行业，快速调动企业数据库中符合该行业的所有人工智能机器的学习资料，解决了现有的学习装置并不能够根据使用者的身份信息识别该使用者所在部门，无法为使用者提供该行业所涉及的人工智能机器，影响使用者学习效率的技术问题。

The utility model discloses a machine learning equipment of artificial intelligence relates to machine learning equipment technical field, include: mount pad, display mechanism, recognition mechanism, power supply mechanism and heat dissipation mechanism, set up the installation cavity in the mount pad, installation cavity internal fixed mounting has the host computer main part, one side fixed mounting at mount pad top has the desktop starter, host computer main part and desktop starter electric connection. The utility model discloses in, through card reader identification user identity information to the trade that this user went into in the reading database, the learning materials of all artificial intelligence machines that accord with this trade in the database of quick adjustment enterprise has solved current learning device and can not be according to this user's department of identity information identification, can't provide the artificial intelligence machine that this trade relates for the user, influences the technical problem of user learning efficiency.

Machine learning equipment of artificial intelligenceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a machine learning equipment technical field especially relates to an artificial intelligence's machine learning equipment.

Background

Artificial intelligence is a new technical science for researching and developing theories, methods, technologies and application systems for simulating, extending and expanding human intelligence, and also relates to multiple disciplines such as information theory, cybernetics, automation, bionics, biology, psychology, mathematical logic, linguistics, medicine, philosophy and the like;

the prior patent (publication number: CN212480686U) discloses an electronic machine learning device, which detects the speed change of the device through an acceleration sensor, then transmits information to a singlechip, the singlechip controls the power failure between a first electromagnet and a second electromagnet, the first electromagnet and the second electromagnet are separated, a buffer spring resets to enable an elastic rubber block to pop up, and the elastic rubber block is contacted with the ground to realize the buffer effect, thereby avoiding the damage of the device body.

However, the electronic machine learning apparatus described above still has the following problems in practical use: along with the continuous development of present science and technology level, artificial intelligence machine also increases gradually, the manufacture factory also needs the operation mode that the production workman can skillfully master artificial intelligence machine, but above-mentioned learning device can not be according to user's identity information recognition this user department of place, consequently can't provide the artificial intelligence machine that this trade is related for the user, need the manual study data of seeking of user, influence user's learning efficiency, current artificial intelligence machine learning equipment can only realize the application through external power supply mostly simultaneously, it has certain use limitation under more occasions, there is certain defect in the aspect of the practicality.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a machine learning equipment of artificial intelligence has solved current learning device and can not be according to user's identity information discernment this user department of residence to can't provide the artificial intelligence machine that this trade relates for the user, influence user's learning efficiency's technical problem.

In order to solve the technical problem, the utility model provides a pair of machine learning equipment of artificial intelligence includes: the multifunctional desktop starter is characterized by comprising a mounting seat, a display mechanism, an identification mechanism, a power supply mechanism and a heat dissipation mechanism, wherein a mounting cavity is formed in the mounting seat, a host main body is fixedly mounted in the mounting cavity, a desktop starter is fixedly mounted on one side of the top of the mounting seat, the host main body is electrically connected with the desktop starter, a plurality of air inlets are formed in one side of the mounting seat at equal intervals, an exhaust hole is formed in the other side of the mounting seat, a plurality of air guide covers are fixedly mounted on the exhaust hole towards the outer side at equal intervals, universal wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the mounting seat, the display mechanism is located at the top of the mounting seat, the identification mechanism is arranged on one side of the top of the mounting seat, the power supply mechanism is located in the mounting cavity, and the heat dissipation mechanism is only located at the inner bottom and the inner top of the mounting cavity;

the display mechanism comprises two support frames, the two support frames are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting seat, a rotating shaft hole is formed in one side of each support frame, a damping rotating shaft is rotatably connected in each rotating shaft hole, a display is fixedly arranged on one side opposite to the two damping rotating shafts, and the display is electrically connected with the main machine body;

the identification mechanism comprises a card reader, the card reader is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting seat, a communication circuit is fixedly arranged in the mounting cavity, and the communication circuit is electrically connected with the server;

the power supply mechanism comprises a storage battery, the storage battery is fixedly arranged at the inner bottom of the installation cavity, a UPS is fixedly arranged at the inner top of the installation cavity, and the UPS is electrically connected with the main body of the host machine, the communication circuit and the display respectively;

the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a plurality of fixing seats, each fixing seat is symmetrically and fixedly installed at the inner bottom and the inner bottom of the installation cavity and at the same side, a heat dissipation motor is fixedly installed at one side, opposite to the fixing seat, of the fixing seat, and a plurality of fan blades are fixedly installed at the outer side of the rotating end of the heat dissipation motor at equal intervals.

Preferably, the front surface of the desktop starter is provided with two USB slots, and the front surface of the desktop starter is provided with an earphone slot.

Preferably, a mounting groove has been seted up to one side of mount pad, fixed mounting has the socket that charges in the mounting groove, the socket that charges and UPS power electric connection, just it has the safety cover to peg graft in the mounting groove.

Preferably, locating rods are fixedly mounted at the inner top and the inner bottom of the mounting cavity, locating seats are fixedly mounted on the opposite sides of the two locating rods, and the rotating ends of the heat dissipation motors are located in the locating seats.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a pair of machine learning equipment of artificial intelligence has following beneficial effect:

1. the utility model discloses in, through the card reader identification user identity information to the trade that this user went into in the reading database, the learning materials of all artificial intelligence machines that accord with this trade in the quick adjustment enterprise database, and show the data through communication circuit and host computer main part and supply the workman to study on the display, through seeking fast in order to promote learning efficiency to learning materials.

2. The utility model discloses in, can make host computer main part and display can break away from the external power supply through the installation of battery and UPS power, make the device can be applicable to the occasion that does not have the external power supply to promote the device's application range.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of an artificial intelligence machine learning device;

FIG. 2 is a front cross-sectional view of an artificial intelligence machine learning device;

FIG. 3 is an enlarged view of the structure at A in FIG. 1;

fig. 4 is a system diagram of an artificial intelligence machine learning device.

Reference numbers in the figures: 1. a mounting seat; 2. a mounting cavity; 3. a host body; 4. a communication circuit; 5. a support frame; 6. a rotating shaft hole; 7. a damping rotating shaft; 8. a display; 9. a desktop starter; 10. a card reader; 11. a storage battery; 12. a UPS power supply; 13. an air inlet; 14. an exhaust hole; 15. a fixed seat; 16. a heat dissipation motor; 17. a fan blade; 18. positioning a rod; 19. positioning seats; 20. mounting grooves; 21. a charging socket; 22. a pod; 23. a USB slot; 24. an earphone slot; 25. a protective cover; 26. a universal wheel.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments; based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Embodiment one, given by fig. 1-4, the present invention includes: the mounting seat comprises a mounting seat 1, a display mechanism, an identification mechanism, a power supply mechanism and a heat dissipation mechanism, wherein a mounting cavity 2 is formed in the mounting seat 1, a host main body 3 is fixedly mounted in the mounting cavity 2, a desktop starter 9 is fixedly mounted on one side of the top of the mounting seat 1, the host main body 3 is electrically connected with the desktop starter 9, a plurality of air inlet holes 13 are formed in one side of the mounting seat 1 at equal intervals, an exhaust hole 14 is formed in the other side of the mounting seat 1, a plurality of flow guide covers 22 are fixedly mounted on the exhaust hole 14 towards the outer side at equal intervals, universal wheels 26 are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the mounting seat 1, the display mechanism is positioned at the top of the mounting seat 1, the identification mechanism is arranged on one side of the top of the mounting seat 1, the power supply mechanism is positioned in the mounting cavity 2, and the heat dissipation mechanism is only arranged at the inner bottom and the inner top of the mounting cavity 2;

the display mechanism comprises two support frames 5, the two support frames 5 are symmetrically and fixedly installed at the top of the installation seat 1, a rotating shaft hole 6 is formed in one side of each support frame 5, a damping rotating shaft 7 is rotatably connected in each rotating shaft hole 6, a display 8 is fixedly installed on one side opposite to the two damping rotating shafts 7, and the display 8 is electrically connected with the host main body 3;

the identification mechanism comprises a card reader 10, the card reader 10 is fixedly installed at the top of the installation base 1, a communication circuit 4 is fixedly installed in the installation cavity 2, and the communication circuit 4 is electrically connected with the server;

the power supply mechanism comprises a storage battery 11, the storage battery 11 is fixedly arranged at the inner bottom of the installation cavity 2, a UPS 12 is fixedly arranged at the inner top of the installation cavity 2, and the UPS 12 is electrically connected with the host machine main body 3, the communication circuit 4 and the display 8 respectively;

the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a plurality of fixing seats 15, each fixing seat 15 is symmetrically and fixedly installed at the inner bottom and the inner bottom of the installation cavity 2, a heat dissipation motor 16 is fixedly installed at one side opposite to the fixing seat 15 at the same side, a plurality of fan blades 17 are fixedly installed at the outer side of the rotating end of the heat dissipation motor 16 at equal intervals, when a user needs to learn the operation mode of the artificial intelligent machine, the user firstly inserts a self work card into a card slot in the card reader 10, the card reader identifies the information in the work card and sends the identified information to the host main body 3, the identified information is compared with the information in a self-contained memory in the host main body 3 through the host main body 3 so as to read the industry of the user, the model of the artificial intelligent machine used by the user in the industry is sent to the communication circuit 4, and the communication circuit 4 is in signal connection with the internet, and the communication circuit 4 can be connected with a server of the enterprise through the internet, the learning data which are stored in the server and are needed by the related user industry are dispatched into the host main body 3, the needed learning data are displayed through the display 8, when the intelligent power supply device is used in a place without independent power supply, the storage battery 11 can transmit the direct current stored inside to the UPS 12, the UPS 12 can convert the direct current into alternating current through an inverter arranged inside, and the current is transmitted into the host main body 3, the communication circuit 4 and the display 8.

In the second embodiment, on the basis of the first embodiment, two USB slots 23 are provided on the front surface of the desktop starter 9, an earphone slot 24 is provided on the front surface of the desktop starter 9, and the USB slot 23 provided on the front surface of the desktop starter 9 enables a user to copy learning data through a mobile storage device such as a USB disk and a mobile hard disk for learning, and the earphone slot 24 is installed to enable the user to insert an earphone during learning, thereby preventing interference with the learning of nearby users.

In the third embodiment, on the basis of the first embodiment, a mounting groove 20 is formed in one side of the mounting seat 1, a charging socket 21 is fixedly mounted in the mounting groove 20, the charging socket 21 is electrically connected with the UPS power supply 12, and a protection cover 25 is inserted into the mounting groove 20, so that the charging socket 21 can be mounted to charge the UPS power supply 12 through the charging socket 21 when the power in the storage battery 11 is exhausted, and six points of the power are converted into direct current through a rectifier in the UPS power supply 12 and then are transmitted to the storage battery 11 to be stored.

In the fourth embodiment, on the basis of the first embodiment, the positioning rods 18 are fixedly mounted on the inner top and the inner bottom of the mounting cavity 2, the positioning seat 19 is fixedly mounted on one side of each of the two positioning rods 18 opposite to each other, and the rotating end of the heat dissipation motor 16 is located in the positioning seat 19, so that the rotating end of the heat dissipation motor 16 can be fixed by the positioning seat 19 through the mounting of the positioning rods 18 and the positioning seats 19, and the rotating end of the heat dissipation motor 16 and the fan blades 17 can be prevented from being damaged.

The working principle is as follows:

when the user needs to learn the operation mode of the artificial intelligence machine, the identification mechanism is started:

the first step is as follows: when a user needs to learn the operation mode of the artificial intelligent machine, the user inserts a working card into a card slot in the card reader 10, the card reader identifies information in the working card and sends the identified information to the host main body 3;

the second step is that: the identified information is compared with the information in a self-contained memory in the host main body 3 through the host main body 3 so as to read the industry of the user, and the model of an artificial intelligent machine used by the user in the industry is sent to the communication circuit 4, and the communication circuit 4 is in signal connection with the internet;

the third step: the communication circuit 4 can be connected with a server of an enterprise through the internet, and dispatches learning materials which are stored in the server and are required by the industry of the related user to the main body 3 of the host computer, and displays the required learning materials through the display 8.

When the power supply mechanism is used in a place without independent power supply, the power supply mechanism implements the steps of:

the first step is as follows: when the UPS is used in a place without independent power supply, the storage battery 11 can transmit the internally stored direct current to the UPS power supply 12;

the second step is that: the UPS power source 12 can convert direct current into alternating current through an inverter built therein and supply the current to the main body 3, the communication circuit 4, and the display 8.
